overview.caption: Figure 1. Vibe uses GaslessQ for account operations and deposit settlement, and Enigma for market trades. The actual solver transaction wrapper remains unverified.

runtime.title: Runtime units and their dependencies
runtime.caption: Figure 2. Separate services, storage, queue and contracts. The Vibe proxy-to-GaslessQ mapping is inferred; RPC reads and simulation are distinct from transaction broadcast.

nodes.title: Application proxy

nodes.title: Operation / deposit APIs
nodes.detail: Access checks, dedupe, preflight and status responses.

nodes.detail: Requests, transaction attempts, receipts and statuses.

nodes.detail: API publishes requests; worker consumes them.

operations.title: Signed operation: request to confirmed execution
operations.caption: Figure 3. Numbered responsibilities through the operation lifecycle. Fee quotation and simulation can run concurrently. Each colored label identifies where a step runs.

nodes.title: 1 · Build and sign
nodes.detail: Read required state; create a user or session-key signature.

nodes.title: 2 · Submit through Vibe
nodes.detail: POST /api/gaslessq/operations/relay-instant.

nodes.title: 3 · Validate and dedupe
nodes.detail: Check input, existing request and service fee policy.

nodes.title: 4 · Read and simulate
nodes.detail: API → RPC: payer/fee reads and relay eth_call.

nodes.title: 5 · Contract authorization
nodes.detail: Simulated signature, delegation, expiry and replay checks.

nodes.title: 6 · Persist the request
nodes.detail: Write the queued request to PostgreSQL.

nodes.title: 7 · Publish and acknowledge
nodes.detail: Publish Kafka job separately; then return request_id.

nodes.title: 8 · Recheck and broadcast
nodes.detail: Re-simulate; sign transaction; store tx_hash and submitted.

nodes.title: 9 · Execute and charge
nodes.detail: Gasless → Instant → Account → Core; fees and caps atomic.

nodes.title: 10 · Classify receipt
nodes.detail: Receipt missing: wait. Status 1: succeeded. Status 0: reverted.

nodes.title: 11 · Serve stored result
nodes.detail: Status API reads PostgreSQL and returns status / tx_hash.

nodes.title: 12 · Resolve UI outcome
nodes.detail: Require successful status/hash; refresh action-specific state.

deposits.title: Deposit: collateral arrival to Core credit
deposits.caption: Figure 4. Deposit settlement bypasses InstantLayer. Creation fees apply only when this transaction deploys the selected wallet. A new-account deposit adds a frontend account/balance readiness check.

nodes.title: 1 · Find the deposit wallet
nodes.detail: Read collateral, fee, minimum and deterministic wallet address.

nodes.title: 2 · Deliver collateral
nodes.detail: Transfer or bridge delivers tokens to the destination-chain wallet.

nodes.title: 3 · Accept settlement
nodes.detail: Read balance, simulate, persist and publish settlement request.

nodes.title: 4 · Recheck and submit
nodes.detail: Re-read wallet funding and send the settlement transaction.

nodes.title: 5 · Sweep and collect fees
nodes.detail: Deploy if needed. Net = gross − deposit fee − creation fee.

nodes.title: 6 · Create or verify account
nodes.detail: Destination belongs to owner. New settings come from relayer.

nodes.title: 7 · Credit deposited balance
nodes.detail: depositFor transfers collateral and credits 18-decimal balance.

nodes.title: 8 · Record receipt success
nodes.detail: Service marks succeeded from receipt; stored credit is not reconciled.

nodes.title: 9 · Discover funded account
nodes.detail: New account: enumerate Vibecaps Main, then read Core balance.

trades.title: Market trade: signed intent to position state
trades.caption: Figure 6. The frontend submits trades to Enigma. Acceptance, notifications and chain observations are asynchronous; an accepted temporary ID is not proof of an opened or closed quote.

nodes.title: 1 · Sign the trade intent
nodes.detail: Open: add margin + send quote. Close: requestToClosePosition.

nodes.title: 2 · Submit to Enigma
nodes.detail: POST instant_open or instant_close.

nodes.title: 3 · Track acceptance
nodes.detail: Keep temporary quote ID for open; existing quote ID for close.

nodes.title: 4 · Assemble execution
nodes.detail: Solver code, selected template and outer wrapper not supplied.

nodes.title: 5 · Execute protocol action
nodes.detail: Authorization and account routing; quote open or close fill.

nodes.title: 6 · Receive notifications
nodes.detail: Resolve temporary IDs; react to open/close fill messages.

nodes.title: 7 · Read contract positions
nodes.detail: Enumerate AccountLayer VAs; read Core open positions.

nodes.title: 8 · Determine close progress
nodes.detail: Quote absent or partial size reduced; timeout remains pending.

nodes.title: 9 · Separate margin sweep
nodes.detail: Optional removeMargin via execute-operation; receipt checked.

fees.title: Fee quote and limit protocol
fees.caption: Figure 7. Contract-supported integration path. The supplied GaslessQ service has not adopted these unified quote calls. A successful simulation is deliberately returned through a custom revert.

nodes.title: 1 · Encode the action
nodes.detail: Prepare the same inner calldata for quote and execution.

nodes.title: 2 · Preview fee
nodes.detail: previewFeeQuote: state-based estimate; exact=false.

nodes.title: 3 · Choose cap and sign
nodes.detail: Optional signed fee cap is bound into the operation.

nodes.title: 4 · Request exact simulation
nodes.detail: eth_call with complete signatures, real from and native value.

nodes.title: 5 · Run actual checks
nodes.detail: Execute roles, authorization, action and fee collection in simulation.

nodes.title: 6 · Revert with result
nodes.detail: FeeQuoteResult = simulated success. ExecutionFailed wraps failure.

nodes.title: 7 · Decode and evaluate
nodes.detail: 18-decimal totals and payer breakdown; no state was committed.

nodes.title: 8 · Submit actual action
nodes.detail: Direct action or executeWithFeeLimit; original permissions retained.

nodes.title: 9 · Confirm separately
nodes.detail: Actual receipt and business-state checks still establish completion.

completion.title: From request identifier to business result
completion.caption: Figure 8. GaslessQ completion is receipt-based. Identifying the final account, credited amount or quote requires the subsequent business-state checks.

nodes.title: 1 · Request ID
nodes.detail: Identify a durable operation or deposit request.

nodes.title: 2 · Transaction attempt
nodes.detail: Link request_id to one or more attempts and tx_hash.

nodes.title: 3 · Transaction receipt
nodes.detail: Look up execution result for that exact hash.

nodes.title: 4 · Terminal service status
nodes.detail: Persist succeeded / reverted and publish completion.

nodes.title: 5 · Poll and correlate
nodes.detail: Receive stored status/hash; resolve account or quote identifiers.

nodes.title: 6 · Check business outcome
nodes.detail: Core balance, quote status/size, margin return and finality as needed.

withdrawals.title: Owner withdrawal: wallet funds to recipient
withdrawals.caption: Figure 5. Contract-supported direct withdrawal. The owner submits and pays gas; the inspected Vibe/GaslessQ path does not establish UI adoption. This transfers GaslessWallet funds, not balances held in Core.

nodes.title: 1 · Select wallet and amount
nodes.detail: Owner selects walletId, token, recipient and amount.

nodes.title: 2 · Quote with owner as from
nodes.detail: Preview or simulate; optional totalDebit18 fee cap.

nodes.title: 3 · Bind wallet to caller
nodes.detail: withdrawWalletFunds derives the wallet from msg.sender.

nodes.title: 4 · Deploy and pay if needed
nodes.detail: First deployment fee comes from wallet collateral.

nodes.title: 5 · Transfer to recipient
nodes.detail: ERC20 or native; max amount sends post-fee balance.

nodes.title: 6 · Verify result
nodes.detail: Check receipt, WalletFundsWithdrawn and recipient balance.
